description_en: Creates an Airflow instance in a workspace
description_zh: 在工作空间下创建Airflow实例
kebab_example: aliyun dms create-airflow --workspace-id 86302423820000 --airflow-name testairflow --description order_scheduler --app-spec SMALL --worker-serverless-replicas 0 --vpc-id vpc-uf63r6coyiw9o50000 --vswitch-id vsw-8vbaf073jawozfp0000 --security-group-id sg-bp108t8ldzeyk10000 --oss-bucket-name oss-test --oss-path /airflow --startup-file default/startup.sh --requirement-file default/requirements.txt --dags-dir default/dags --plugins-dir default/plugins --graceful-shutdown-timeout 60 --enable-serverless true --data-mount-info-list example-string --airflow-version 3.1 --client-token token-0000 --zone-id cn-hangzhou-h --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateAirflow
